avoidWhen: Avoid when no photography or visual capture is involved.

altText: Mini Michael rejects a red X window and points toward a green check window.

avoidWhen: Avoid if the options are nuanced rather than clearly right or wrong.

title: Michael Points to Rising Growth
description: Mini Michael wears a navy suit and dark sunglasses while pointing with both hands toward a green line chart climbing sharply upward.
altText: Mini Michael in sunglasses points toward a sharply rising green chart.

avoidWhen: Avoid unless the upward trend is supported by real data.

altText: Worried Mini Michael works at a laptop beside a mug and stacked papers.
useWhen: Use when content covers illustrate deadline pressure, introduce a difficult computer task, or discuss workplace anxiety.
avoidWhen: Avoid when the work experience is calm and routine.

title: Michael Explains the Evidence Board

altText: Mini Michael presents a clue board linked with pins and red string.

avoidWhen: Avoid if relationships between the items are speculative or unverified.

altText: Mini Michael holds an AI tablet beside an overflowing folder marked 999+.
